method: KiCad exported netlist + bounded DC calculations; no physical test / SPICE
isolation_topology: PASS: controller and ten host domains remain separate through defined barriers
led_conditions: 0..5V on each input, OFF differential <=0.2V, ON >=1.4V; resistor effective 1.5% including temperature allowance, host rail +/-3%, combined comparator input error +/-14mV. Motherboard envelope must be measured.
timer_note: Timing capacitance under DC bias and temperature is unmeasured; 8..25s is a qualification target, not a guaranteed bound. Static stall releases; repeated edges can trigger further windows.
